note: Proposed event schema for the partner-pairing invitation screen. Names are snake_case, past tense for completed actions.

common_properties.local_hour: int 0-23, user's local hour (needed for the 9 PM-midnight analysis)

events.name: pairing_screen_viewed
events.trigger: Invitation screen is rendered and visible for at least 500 ms

events.name: invite_sent
events.trigger: OS share sheet returns success, or in-app send API returns 2xx

events.name: invite_send_failed
events.trigger: Share sheet cancelled or send API returns non-2xx

events.name: invite_opened
events.trigger: Partner opens the invite link (server-side event)

validation_rules: invite_sent must be preceded by invite_channel_selected in the same session
pairing_completed.invite_id must match an earlier invite_sent.invite_id
Event counts per platform should be within 10% of each other for the same user volume
No duplicate (user_id, event, invite_id) rows within 5 seconds
